description: React component for displaying detailed execution tree and node details, including sharing, copying ID, and dynamic tree building with virtual nodes.

classes.name: CustomTreeItem
classes.description: Custom tree item component with virtual node support and status-based icons.

classes.name: CustomLabel
classes.description: Custom label component for tree nodes, displaying icons and labels based on node type.

methods.name: getIconColor
methods.description: Returns color string based on node status.

methods.name: buildTreeData
methods.description: Transforms execution nodes into a hierarchical tree with virtual iteration nodes.

methods.name: handleNodeSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a tree node, updating the selected item state.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies execution ID to clipboard and shows snackbar notification.

methods.name: onSharePublicly
methods.description: Toggles public sharing status of the execution and updates backend.
